description: Trusted local capability registry for Vex-owned tools. Heavy/on-demand apps should stay stopped until requested whenever practical.

apps.name: Vex Bridge
apps.notes: Authenticated LAN gateway and coordinator. Keep this small; capability implementations should progressively move behind app/tool contracts.

apps.name: Vex Cognition / Ollama
apps.notes: Local cognition server. Model residency can be managed independently from the Vex conversation layer.

apps.name: Vex Art / ComfyUI
apps.notes: Heavy renderer. Intentionally on-demand; Bridge currently owns CPU/GPU-safe launch flags until the art runner is fully extracted.

apps.name: Vex Doctor
apps.notes: Independent source-of-truth diagnostics. It does not ask the language model whether a subsystem is healthy.

apps.name: Vex Learning Worker
apps.notes: Currently lives inside Bridge. Extraction target: an independent research/knowledge worker that can sleep when idle.

apps.name: Vex Housekeeper
apps.notes: Currently Bridge-managed. Extraction target with the same protected-file and safe-deletion rules.

apps.name: Vex Media Tools
apps.notes: Future independent media/video/transcode worker. Should only run while a media job exists.

apps.name: Vex Browser / Research Tools
apps.notes: Future independent browser/research worker with stable job/result contracts.
